start: Signed in to HQ, several real gyms exist, the database has update 0030

user_sees: Heading 'All gyms' with button 'Make a gym'
Tiles: Gyms, Members, Free trials ending in N days, Trial ended, not paid, Paying, Need a look
Table: Gym, Free trial or plan, Members, Check-ins 7 / 30 days, Gym takings this month, Last desk activity, Owner

A member name or number anywhere

steps.action: Type part of a gym name, code, owner or mobile in 'Search'

must_not: A gym that matches left out
The count line still saying the full total
Search text lost when the order changes

user_sees: The QA, test-mobile and demo gyms added to the rows and the tiles

Search and filter reset by the tick

user_sees: Search and filter cleared; every real gym listed

steps.action: (No real gyms at all) open HQ

user_sees: A warning note that the free-trial part needs the database update; no trial tiles, column, filters or sort
